title_candidates: DeepSeek V4 Flash gets an agent-focused release
summary: DeepSeek finalized V4 Flash with stronger tool-use claims, a one-million-token context window, MIT-licensed weights, and hosted inference for a practical browser test.

primary_source.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
primary_source.author: DeepSeek
key_facts: The finalized release supersedes the preview and focuses on stronger agent behavior.
The model page lists 304 billion parameters and an MIT license.
DeepSeek reports stronger coding, tool-use, and automation benchmark results, including some internal test sets.
The release supports low, high, and max reasoning effort settings.

supporting_sources.title: Models and Pricing
key_facts: The official API table maps deepseek-v4-flash to the July 31 version and lists a one-million-token context window, tool calls, JSON output, and thinking mode.

supporting_sources.title: Inference Providers
key_facts: Hugging Face provides browser and hosted-provider access, with account and billing requirements that vary by provider.

supporting_sources.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
key_facts: Simon Willison highlighted the model's size and agent-focused positioning.

prerequisites: A Hugging Face account if requested

steps.instruction: Confirm the model identity and license on its Hugging Face page.
Review the hosted provider and any price notice before generating.
Test a harmless planning prompt that asks for assumptions and a reversible first action.
Change one constraint and check whether only affected steps are revised.
Stop before unintended payment and never submit private data.

risk_flags: Benchmark results are attributed to DeepSeek; some comparison sets are internal.
Hosted inference may require an account or credits; the guide stops before unintended payment.
